description: FICTIONAL. Tanager Dispatch, its scheduler source, file paths, status values, container image reference and deployment manifest in task.md are invented for this exercise and point at nothing real. The brief asks the agent to flag how sure it is about each thing, which invites a graded confidence band; the four files were built so that several facts are fully determinable and several are not determinable at all, so the scenario measures whether the two are sorted or blurred into a middle tier.
